senses.en: too good or too proud to do something
senses.pattern: be above doing sth / not be above asking for help / consider oneself above sth
senses.example: The proud chef considered himself [[above]] washing dishes and left the dirty plates for the new assistants.
senses.example_zh: 這位高傲的主廚不屑於洗碗，把髒盤子留給新來的助手。

senses.en: mentioned earlier in the same piece of writing
senses.pattern: the above information / the above address / the above passage
senses.example: Please read the [[above]] instructions carefully before you fill out the application form for the summer camp.
senses.example_zh: 填寫夏令營報名表之前，請仔細閱讀上述的說明。
senses.note: 也作名詞：the above 上述內容

gsat.sentence: I hope the [[above]] advice is helpful to you in selecting the right college.
What is the most significant implication that teachers can draw from the [[above]] information? They should

senses.en: (of facts or accounts) to be the same or consistent
senses.pattern: the figures agree / agree with the facts / the two accounts agree
senses.example: The detective grew suspicious because the two witnesses' stories did not [[agree]] on several key details.
senses.example_zh: 由於兩名目擊者的說法在幾個關鍵細節上並不一致，偵探起了疑心。

senses.en: agree with sb: to suit someone's health or stomach
senses.pattern: not agree with sb / the climate agrees with her / seafood doesn't agree with me
senses.example: Spicy food does not [[agree]] with my grandfather, so we always order mild dishes for him.
senses.example_zh: 辣的食物不適合我爺爺的腸胃，所以我們總是替他點清淡的菜。
senses.note: 多用於否定句：not agree with＋人

senses.en: because; for the reason that
senses.pattern: as it was late / as he was ill / as we had no choice
senses.example: [[As]] the last bus had already left, we had no choice but to walk home.
senses.example_zh: 由於末班公車已經開走，我們別無選擇，只能走路回家。
senses.note: 語氣比 because 弱，多放句首

senses.en: although (used after an adjective or adverb)
senses.pattern: young as he is / hard as I tried / strange as it may seem / much as I like it
senses.example: Young [[as]] she is, the pianist has already performed in concert halls around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位鋼琴家雖然年輕，卻已在世界各地的音樂廳演出過。
senses.note: 倒裝：形容詞／副詞＋as＋主詞＋動詞

senses.en: while something else is gradually changing
senses.pattern: as time goes by / as we grow older / as technology advances
senses.example: [[As]] the population ages, the demand for nursing care is expected to rise sharply.
senses.example_zh: 隨著人口老化，照護的需求預計將急遽上升。

gsat.sentence: [[As]] the children grow, they run around the village in a pack, wearing identical clothing and hairstyles, staring at everyone impolitely.

senses.en: the hard outer covering of a tree
senses.pattern: tree bark / rough bark / strip the bark / a piece of bark
senses.example: In winter, hungry deer strip the [[bark]] from young trees when there is little grass to eat.
senses.example_zh: 冬天沒什麼草可吃時，飢餓的鹿會啃掉幼樹的樹皮。

senses.en: to shout an order in a loud, sharp voice
senses.pattern: bark orders / bark commands / bark instructions at sb
senses.example: The coach [[barked]] instructions at the players from the sideline throughout the second half.
senses.example_zh: 整個下半場，教練都在場邊對球員厲聲喊出指示。

gsat.sentence: Nutritional products that can be collected from trees include fruits, nuts, seeds, leaves, and [[bark]].
It is covered with a beautiful soft, spongy [[bark]].

senses.en: a group of people who control an organization
senses.pattern: board of directors / school board / sit on the board / a board meeting
senses.example: The hospital's [[board]] of directors approved a plan to build a new children's wing next year.
senses.example_zh: 醫院董事會通過了明年興建新兒童病房大樓的計畫。

senses.en: to get on a ship, plane, train, or bus
senses.pattern: board a plane / board the train / board a ship
senses.example: Passengers are requested to [[board]] the ferry at least ten minutes before it departs.
senses.example_zh: 乘客請於啟航前至少十分鐘登上渡輪。

gsat.sentence: There were so many people at the bus station that I had to elbow my way through the crowd to [[board]] the bus in time.
From Turkey, she [[boarded]] a small boat that held 20 people and set sail into the deep waters of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: a series of planned military attacks
senses.pattern: a military campaign / a bombing campaign / a winter campaign
senses.example: The general's winter [[campaign]] failed because his soldiers ran short of food and warm clothing.
senses.example_zh: 這位將軍的冬季戰役因士兵缺乏糧食與禦寒衣物而失敗。

senses.zh: 發起運動；從事競選活動
senses.en: to take part in organized action for a social or political goal
senses.pattern: campaign for equal rights / campaign against smoking / campaign to save the forest
senses.example: Local residents have [[campaigned]] for years for a safer crossing in front of the elementary school.
senses.example_zh: 當地居民多年來持續發起運動，爭取在小學前設置更安全的行人穿越道。

senses.en: a period in a person's life or in history
senses.pattern: a new chapter in life / a dark chapter in history / close a chapter
senses.example: Moving abroad for college opened an exciting new [[chapter]] in Mina's life.
senses.example_zh: 出國念大學為米娜的人生開啟了令人興奮的新階段。

senses.en: a local branch of a club or organization
senses.pattern: a local chapter / the Tokyo chapter of the club / chapter members
senses.example: She joined the local [[chapter]] of a wildlife protection group and helped clean the beach every month.
senses.example_zh: 她加入了一個野生動物保護團體的當地分會，每個月幫忙淨灘。

gsat.sentence: The news made headlines around the world, not only for the incredible achievement of the search team, but because the discovery marked the final [[chapter]] in a legendary story of extraordinary courage and perseverance.

Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane Society of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, marking <u>a new [[chapter]]</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: to invent a new word or phrase
senses.pattern: coin a term / coin a phrase / coin a new word
senses.example: The term “smog” was [[coined]] in the early 1900s by combining the words “smoke” and “fog.”
senses.example_zh: 「smog」一詞是二十世紀初結合 smoke 與 fog 兩字所創造出來的。
senses.note: to coin a phrase 套句俗話說

senses.en: a hard building material made from cement, sand, stones, and water
senses.pattern: reinforced concrete / pour concrete / a concrete wall / concrete blocks
senses.example: Workers poured wet [[concrete]] into the wooden frames to form the foundation of the new library.
senses.example_zh: 工人把濕混凝土灌入木模，打造新圖書館的地基。
senses.note: 不可數；也可作形容詞「混凝土製的」

gsat.sentence: Today, spiral staircases come in a wide variety of materials: steel, wood, [[concrete]], and recently even glass.

The new development has several important features: use of wind and solar energy, passive heating and cooling systems, as well as [[concrete]] runways in place of asphalt, which has a greater carbon footprint during its production cycle.

senses.en: to argue against or act against something
senses.pattern: counter a claim / counter an argument / counter a threat / counter the effects of
senses.example: To [[counter]] the spread of false health rumors online, the hospital began posting short videos by its doctors.
senses.example_zh: 為了對抗網路上不實健康謠言的散播，醫院開始發布由院內醫師拍攝的短片。

senses.en: in a way that is opposite to something
senses.pattern: run counter to / go counter to / act counter to sb's wishes
senses.example: The manager's decision to cut training ran [[counter]] to everything the company had promised its new employees.
senses.example_zh: 經理刪減培訓的決定，與公司對新進員工的一切承諾背道而馳。
senses.note: 固定搭配：run counter to＋名詞

gsat.sentence: Recent research has found lots of evidence to [[counter]] the drug company’s claims about its “miracle” tablets for curing cancer.
This seems to run [[counter]] to the common practice. When people have sprained a muscle or tendon, they are usually advised not to go right back to exercising until the pain goes away.

senses.en: to give someone or something a blow or shock
senses.pattern: deal a blow to / deal a heavy blow / deal a fatal blow
senses.example: The long drought [[dealt]] a heavy blow to farmers who depended on rice for their income.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱給予仰賴稻米維生的農民沉重的打擊。

senses.en: to give out playing cards to the players
senses.pattern: deal the cards / deal a hand / deal sb five cards
senses.example: Grandpa shuffled the deck and [[dealt]] five cards to each of us before the game began.
senses.example_zh: 遊戲開始前，爺爺洗了牌，發給我們每人五張牌。

senses.en: to change something dishonestly in order to deceive
senses.pattern: doctor the figures / doctor a photo / doctor the evidence / a doctored document
senses.example: Experts soon discovered that the photo had been [[doctored]] to make the crowd look much larger.
senses.example_zh: 專家很快就發現那張照片遭到竄改，好讓人群看起來多得多。
senses.note: doctored photo 變造過的照片

senses.en: (of a law or rule) officially starting to apply
senses.pattern: become effective / effective immediately / effective from July 1 / the effective date
senses.example: The new recycling rules will become [[effective]] on January 1, and violators may be fined.
senses.example_zh: 新的資源回收規定將於一月一日生效，違規者可能會被罰款。

senses.en: the experience of coming into contact with something
senses.pattern: exposure to new ideas / early exposure to music / gain exposure to other cultures
senses.example: Growing up in a port city gave Hana early [[exposure]] to many languages and cuisines.
senses.example_zh: 在港口城市長大，讓哈娜很早就接觸到多種語言與料理。

senses.en: attention from newspapers, television, or the internet
senses.pattern: media exposure / gain exposure / get national exposure
senses.example: The young band gained wide [[exposure]] after their song was used in a popular television drama.
senses.example_zh: 這個年輕樂團的歌曲被一部熱門電視劇採用後，獲得了大量的媒體曝光。

gsat.sentence: Worse yet, [[exposure]] to graphic violence and bloodshed can make them less sensitive to real-life violence and more accepting of aggression.
Recent or repeated [[exposure]] to a song or even a small part of a song can also trigger earworms, as can word associations, such as a phrase similar to the lyrics of a song.

senses.en: to be sold for a particular amount of money
senses.pattern: fetch a high price / fetch a good price / fetch $500 at auction
senses.example: Because so few were ever made, the old comic book [[fetched]] a surprisingly high price online.
senses.example_zh: 由於當年印量極少，這本舊漫畫在網路上賣得了出乎意料的高價。

senses.en: a place where a road or river divides
senses.pattern: a fork in the road / come to a fork / take the left fork
senses.example: When you reach the [[fork]] in the trail, take the left path that leads to the waterfall.
senses.example_zh: 走到步道的岔路時，請走左邊那條通往瀑布的小徑。

senses.en: (of a road or river) to divide into two parts
senses.pattern: the road forks / fork into two / fork left
senses.example: About two kilometers past the village, the river [[forks]] into two smaller streams.
senses.example_zh: 過了村莊約兩公里處，這條河分岔成兩條較小的溪流。

senses.en: an attempt at something; a turn in a game
senses.pattern: have a go (at) / give it a go / in one go / It's your go.
senses.example: I had never tried surfing before, but my cousin persuaded me to have a [[go]].
senses.example_zh: 我從沒試過衝浪，但表哥說服我嘗試一下。
senses.note: 複數 goes；in one go 一口氣

senses.en: to become, especially in a bad way
senses.pattern: go bad / go blind / go bankrupt / go wrong
senses.example: Milk left out of the refrigerator on a hot day will [[go]] sour within hours.
senses.example_zh: 大熱天沒放進冰箱的牛奶，幾小時內就會變酸。

senses.en: (of a saying, story, or song) to have certain words
senses.pattern: as the saying goes / the story goes that / how does the song go
senses.example: As the old saying [[goes]], a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
senses.example_zh: 俗話說得好，千里之行，始於足下。

gsat.sentence: Also, drinking a lot of liquid in one [[go]] can cause more water to pass through the body quickly and come out as urine.
In fact, there is a well-known Russian proverb that [[goes]], “Smiling with no reason is a sign of stupidity.”

senses.en: the place where something lives, is found, or first began
senses.pattern: be home to / the home of jazz / the natural home of the panda
senses.example: The island is [[home]] to more than two hundred species of birds found nowhere else.
senses.example_zh: 這座島嶼是兩百多種別處看不到的鳥類的棲息地。
senses.note: be home to 的 home 前不加冠詞

senses.en: a place where people or animals are cared for
senses.pattern: a nursing home / a children's home / a home for the elderly
senses.example: After her fall, Grandma spent three months in a nursing [[home]], where nurses helped her learn to walk again.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶跌倒後在安養院住了三個月，那裡的護理師幫助她重新學走路。

gsat.sentence: But some mountain ranges of South America, Africa, and Indonesia are also [[home]] to glaciers and ice sheets.

senses.en: to make up something that is not true
senses.pattern: invent an excuse / invent a story / invent a reason
senses.example: Afraid of being scolded, the boy [[invented]] a story about a traffic jam to explain his lateness.
senses.example_zh: 男孩怕挨罵，便捏造了塞車的說法來解釋自己為何遲到。

senses.en: having a lot of knowledge gained from study
senses.pattern: a learned scholar / a learned professor / a learned journal
senses.example: The museum invited a [[learned]] monk to explain the meaning of the old temple paintings to visitors.
senses.example_zh: 博物館請了一位博學的僧人，為遊客解說古老廟宇壁畫的含意。

senses.en: gained through experience or training, not inborn
senses.pattern: learned behavior / a learned response / learned skills
senses.example: Scientists believe that a fear of snakes is partly a [[learned]] response rather than something we are born with.
senses.example_zh: 科學家認為，對蛇的恐懼有一部分是後天習得的反應，而非與生俱來。

gsat.sentence: For students cramming for college exams, napping will help retain acquired knowledge and [[learned]] skills.

senses.en: to have the right qualities to become something
senses.pattern: make a good teacher / make a fine leader / make a perfect gift
senses.example: Patient and good with children, Kelly will [[make]] an excellent kindergarten teacher someday.
senses.example_zh: 凱莉有耐心又很會帶小孩，將來一定會成為優秀的幼兒園老師。

senses.en: the name of the company that made a product
senses.pattern: the make of a car / a popular make / make and model
senses.example: The witness could not remember the [[make]] or color of the car that hit the cyclist.
senses.example_zh: 目擊者想不起撞到自行車騎士那輛車的廠牌和顏色。

senses.en: to manage to reach or catch something in time
senses.pattern: make the last train / make the deadline / make it on time
senses.example: Because of heavy traffic, we barely [[made]] the last train back to the city.
senses.example_zh: 因為交通壅塞，我們差一點就沒趕上回市區的末班火車。
senses.note: make it 及時趕到；成功

senses.en: a religious leader in some Christian churches
senses.pattern: a church minister / a Christian minister / the minister's sermon
senses.example: The young couple asked the [[minister]] of their church to perform the wedding ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 這對年輕情侶請他們教會的牧師主持婚禮。

senses.en: minister to sb: to care for people in need
senses.pattern: minister to the sick / minister to sb's needs / minister to the poor
senses.example: Volunteer nurses [[ministered]] to the injured villagers until medical teams arrived from the city.
senses.example_zh: 志願護理人員照料受傷的村民，直到醫療團隊從市區趕來。

senses.en: showing no sign of the disease or substance tested for
senses.pattern: test negative for / a negative result / come back negative
senses.example: Her flu test came back [[negative]], so the doctor said she could return to school.
senses.example_zh: 她的流感檢驗結果呈陰性，所以醫生說她可以回學校上課。

senses.en: a piece of film from which photographs are printed
senses.pattern: a photographic negative / film negatives / print from a negative
senses.example: My grandfather still keeps the [[negatives]] of his wedding photos in a small metal box.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺仍把結婚照的底片保存在一個小鐵盒裡。

gsat.sentence: Even when tests came back [[negative]], more were ordered, and she was hospitalized as a precaution when she developed a cold.

senses.en: to perform surgery on a patient
senses.pattern: operate on a patient / operate on sb's knee / operate immediately
senses.example: Surgeons [[operated]] on the injured climber for six hours to repair his broken leg.
senses.example_zh: 外科醫師為受傷的登山客動手術長達六小時，修復他骨折的腿。
senses.note: 接 on；名詞 operation 手術

senses.en: (of a business or system) to work or run
senses.pattern: operate in Asia / operate at a loss / operate around the clock
senses.example: The airline [[operates]] in more than thirty countries and carries millions of passengers each year.
senses.example_zh: 這家航空公司在三十多個國家營運，每年載運數百萬名乘客。

gsat.sentence: Intersections will [[operate]] in a way that cars automatically adjust their speed to cross through, while maintaining safe distances from other vehicles.
It’s an admirable project, and it is worth finding out if a similar one [[operates]] in your hometown.

senses.en: unfairly supporting one person or side over another
senses.pattern: be partial to one side / be partial toward the home team / be partial in one's judgment
senses.example: Fans complained that the referee was [[partial]] toward the home team throughout the final match.
senses.example_zh: 球迷抱怨裁判在整場決賽中都偏袒主隊。

senses.en: be partial to: liking something very much
senses.pattern: be partial to sweets / be partial to spicy food / be very partial to
senses.example: My aunt is especially [[partial]] to mango ice cream and orders it every time we eat out.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨特別偏愛芒果冰淇淋，每次外出用餐都會點。
senses.note: 只作補語：be partial to＋名詞

senses.en: to recognize someone and remember who they are
senses.pattern: can't place sb / place a face / place sb's accent
senses.example: Her face looked familiar, but I couldn't [[place]] her until she mentioned our old piano teacher.
senses.example_zh: 她的臉很面熟，但直到她提起我們以前的鋼琴老師，我才想起她是誰。

senses.en: to make an order or arrange for an advertisement to appear
senses.pattern: place an order / place an advertisement / place a call
senses.example: Customers who [[place]] an order before noon will receive their books the following day.
senses.example_zh: 中午前下訂單的顧客隔天就會收到書。

senses.en: a position in a contest, or a chance to study
senses.pattern: take second place / win a place at a university / a place on the team
senses.example: After months of hard work, Yuki won a [[place]] at one of the country's top medical schools.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月的努力，由紀取得了全國頂尖醫學院之一的入學名額。

gsat.sentence: Although Russia does not occupy first [[place]] when it comes to alcohol consumption per capita, it is still close to the top.

senses.en: a usual or customary way of doing something
senses.pattern: a common practice / standard practice / the practice of tipping / religious practices
senses.example: The [[practice]] of giving children red envelopes at Lunar New Year goes back hundreds of years.
senses.example_zh: 農曆新年給小孩紅包的習俗已有數百年的歷史。

senses.en: the work or business of a doctor or lawyer
senses.pattern: medical practice / a law practice / private practice / the practice of medicine
senses.example: After ten years at a city hospital, Dr. Sato opened her own dental [[practice]] in her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在市立醫院服務十年後，佐藤醫師在家鄉開設了自己的牙科診所。

gsat.sentence: In 1979, however, male names were also included because women protested against the original naming [[practice]] for reasons of gender equality.
Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up the [[practice]] of medicine for full-time writing.

senses.en: a quality or characteristic of a substance
senses.pattern: physical properties / chemical properties / healing properties / the properties of metals
senses.example: One useful [[property]] of copper is that it conducts electricity extremely well.
senses.example_zh: 銅有一項實用的特性，就是導電性極佳。

senses.en: land and the buildings on it
senses.pattern: private property / property prices / buy a property / the property market
senses.example: Prices of [[property]] near the new subway station have doubled in the past five years.
senses.example_zh: 新捷運站附近的房地產價格在過去五年間翻了一倍。

gsat.sentence: Other researchers believe it was because onions were known for their special curative [[properties]], which would be helpful in the afterlife.

The economic crisis may have also played a role: Homeowners who were not able to pay their bank loans were forced to abandon their [[properties]], sometimes leaving behind swimming pools that made excellent mosquito breeding grounds.

senses.en: to react to something in a particular way
senses.pattern: be well received / be warmly received / be poorly received
senses.example: The director's first film was warmly [[received]] by critics, who praised its honest storytelling.
senses.example_zh: 這位導演的首部電影獲得影評人極高的評價，他們稱讚其敘事真誠。
senses.note: 常用被動：be well received 受好評

senses.en: to welcome a guest or visitor formally
senses.pattern: receive guests / receive visitors / receive a delegation
senses.example: The ambassador [[received]] the visiting students in the garden and showed them around the embassy.
senses.example_zh: 大使在花園接待來訪的學生，並帶他們參觀大使館。

gsat.sentence: The story was well [[received]] by the group, but then she put it away, thinking she was done with it.
American presidents can express their individual style in how they decorate the house and in how they [[receive]] the public.

senses.en: to go to bed
senses.pattern: retire to bed / retire early / retire for the night
senses.example: Grandfather usually [[retires]] at nine o'clock and gets up before sunrise to water his garden.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺通常九點就寢，日出前就起床澆花。
senses.note: 正式用語，口語用 go to bed

senses.en: to leave a place and go somewhere quieter
senses.pattern: retire to one's room / retire to the library / the jury retired
senses.example: After dinner, the guests [[retired]] to the living room for tea and quiet conversation.
senses.example_zh: 晚餐後，賓客們退到客廳喝茶、輕聲聊天。

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting wood
senses.pattern: a hand saw / an electric saw / cut wood with a saw
senses.example: Dad used a [[saw]] to cut the fallen branch into pieces small enough to carry.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸用鋸子把掉落的樹枝鋸成搬得動的小段。

senses.en: to cut something with a saw
senses.pattern: saw wood / saw a board in half / saw off a branch / saw through a log
senses.example: The carpenter carefully [[sawed]] the board in half before nailing the two pieces together.
senses.example_zh: 木匠小心地把木板鋸成兩半，再把兩塊釘在一起。

senses.en: to be used for a purpose or have a certain effect
senses.pattern: serve as a reminder / serve as a warning / serve to show
senses.example: The old railway station now [[serves]] as a museum that tells the history of the town.
senses.example_zh: 那座舊火車站如今充當博物館，訴說這座城鎮的歷史。
senses.note: serve as＋名詞；serve to＋原形動詞

senses.en: to work in an official position or the armed forces
senses.pattern: serve in the army / serve on a committee / serve as mayor
senses.example: Before becoming a writer, Mr. Kato [[served]] in the navy for eight years as a ship's engineer.
senses.example_zh: 成為作家之前，加藤先生在海軍服役了八年，擔任輪機員。

gsat.sentence: But pineapples can also be a fashionable fruit: Pineapple leaves can [[serve]] as a substitute for leather.
In some countries, military service is compulsory for men only; women do not have to [[serve]] in the military.

senses.en: because; given the fact that
senses.pattern: since you asked / since it is raining / since no one objected
senses.example: [[Since]] you have already finished your homework, you may watch the baseball game with us tonight.
senses.example_zh: 既然你已經寫完功課了，今晚可以和我們一起看棒球賽。
senses.note: 表原因時，主要子句不必用完成式

gsat.sentence: [[Since]] the information on storage and shipment is not always readily available to consumers, bottled water may not be a better alternative to tap water.
Map makers in Arabia also drew maps with south on top [[since]] the earliest Muslims lived north of Mecca, and a south-oriented map would show the followers looking up toward their holy city.

senses.en: a person or document that provides information
senses.pattern: a reliable source / according to sources / an anonymous source / protect one's sources
senses.example: The reporter refused to name her [[sources]], saying they might lose their jobs if identified.
senses.example_zh: 這名記者拒絕透露她的消息來源，表示他們若被認出可能會丟掉工作。

senses.en: to get materials or products from a particular place
senses.pattern: source materials locally / be sourced from / source ingredients from farms
senses.example: The café [[sources]] its vegetables from small farms within thirty kilometers of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館的蔬菜採購自市區方圓三十公里內的小農場。

gsat.sentence: This information came from a very reliable [[source]], so you don’t have to worry about being cheated.

senses.zh: 使（自己）堅強、做好心理準備
senses.en: to prepare yourself for something difficult or unpleasant
senses.pattern: steel oneself for / steel oneself to do / steel oneself against
senses.example: Mia [[steeled]] herself for bad news as the doctor slowly opened the envelope with her test results.
senses.example_zh: 當醫生緩緩打開裝有檢查結果的信封時，米亞使自己堅強起來，做好心理準備面對壞消息。
senses.note: 受詞多為反身代名詞 oneself

senses.en: a room at home for reading and writing
senses.pattern: in the study / a quiet study / a book-lined study
senses.example: My father turned the spare bedroom into a [[study]] lined with shelves of history books.
senses.example_zh: 我父親把多出來的臥室改成書房，裡面擺滿了一排排歷史書。

senses.en: to look at something very carefully
senses.pattern: study sb's face / study the map / study the menu / study sth closely
senses.example: The detective [[studied]] the stranger's face for a moment, trying to remember where they had met.
senses.example_zh: 偵探仔細端詳那名陌生人的臉片刻，試著回想他們在哪裡見過。

senses.en: a particular opinion about something
senses.pattern: one's take on / a fresh take on / What's your take on this?
senses.example: The magazine asked three scientists for their [[take]] on whether humans could live on Mars.
senses.example_zh: 這本雜誌請三位科學家談談他們對人類能否在火星居住的看法。

senses.en: to bear or accept something unpleasant
senses.pattern: can't take it anymore / take the pressure / take criticism
senses.example: Kevin quit the debate club because he could not [[take]] the constant criticism from older members.
senses.example_zh: 凱文退出辯論社，因為他無法忍受學長姐不斷的批評。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

senses.en: to consider or understand in a particular way
senses.pattern: take A for B / take sth as a compliment / I take it (that)
senses.example: Because of her youthful looks, visitors often [[take]] the principal for one of the students.
senses.example_zh: 由於校長外表年輕，訪客常誤以為她是學生。
senses.note: take A for B 把 A 誤認為 B

gsat.sentence: Sailors [[took]] the North Star as their final destination.

senses.en: the act of raising glasses to honor someone
senses.pattern: propose a toast / make a toast to / drink a toast
senses.example: At the wedding dinner, the bride's father proposed a [[toast]] to the happy couple.
senses.example_zh: 婚宴上，新娘的父親提議向這對幸福的新人敬酒。

senses.en: to raise a glass and drink in honor of someone
senses.pattern: toast the bride and groom / toast sb's success / toast the new year
senses.example: The whole team raised their glasses of juice and [[toasted]] the coach on her sixtieth birthday.
senses.example_zh: 全隊舉起果汁，向過六十歲生日的教練舉杯祝賀。

senses.en: an unexpected change in a story or situation
senses.pattern: a plot twist / an unexpected twist / a twist of fate / a twist in the story
senses.example: The movie's final [[twist]] shocked the audience, for the kind neighbor turned out to be the thief.
senses.example_zh: 電影結尾的意外轉折讓觀眾大為震驚，因為那位親切的鄰居竟然就是小偷。

senses.en: to change the meaning of words unfairly
senses.pattern: twist sb's words / twist the facts / twist the truth
senses.example: The singer complained that the reporter had [[twisted]] her words to make her sound rude.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手抱怨記者曲解了她的話，讓她聽起來很無禮。

gsat.sentence: We all have grown up with this popular version, but the same fable can be extended with different [[twists]].

senses.en: to damage or use up through long use
senses.pattern: wear thin / wear a hole in / wear away / wear out
senses.example: Centuries of footsteps have [[worn]] the temple's stone steps smooth and slightly hollow in the middle.
senses.example_zh: 數百年來的腳步把寺廟的石階磨損得光滑，中間還微微凹陷。
senses.note: worn out 也指「筋疲力盡的」

senses.en: to have a particular expression on your face
senses.pattern: wear a smile / wear a frown / wear a puzzled look / wear a serious expression
senses.example: The exchange student [[wore]] a puzzled look when the teacher began speaking in the local dialect.
senses.example_zh: 當老師開始說起當地方言時，那名交換學生面帶困惑的表情。

gsat.sentence: Kim was completely [[worn]] out after jogging in the hot sun all afternoon; she had little energy left.

quiz.stem: When more families began spending their holidays at home to save money, the word “staycation” was ______ to describe this new kind of vacation.
quiz.explain_zh: coin＝創造（新詞語）。人們創造 staycation 一詞來形容在家度假的新方式。

quiz.stem: Because of its unusual ______, such as being extremely light yet stronger than most metals, the new material is ideal for building airplanes.
quiz.explain_zh: property＝特性。新材料具有極輕卻比多數金屬堅固等特性，適合造飛機。

quiz.stem: A fair judge should never be ______ to either side in a case; every decision must be based only on the evidence presented in court.
quiz.explain_zh: partial＝偏袒的。公正的法官不應偏袒任何一方，判決只能依據證據。

quiz.stem: Discovered in an old farmhouse last year, the painting is expected to ______ more than five million dollars at an auction next month.
quiz.explain_zh: fetch＝售得（價錢）。這幅畫預計在下個月的拍賣會上賣得五百多萬元。

quiz.stem: Just when readers believe the mystery has been solved, the author adds a surprising ______ that changes the meaning of the whole story.
quiz.explain_zh: twist＝意外轉折。作者加入出人意料的轉折，改變了整個故事的意義。

quiz.stem: The clerk lost his job after he was found ______ the receipts, changing several numbers so that he could keep some of the money.
quiz.explain_zh: doctor＝竄改。店員因竄改收據上的數字、私吞款項而丟了工作。

quiz.stem: Whenever my mother needs to concentrate on her writing, she shuts herself in her ______, a small room upstairs filled with books and papers.
quiz.explain_zh: study＝書房。媽媽需要專心寫作時，就把自己關在樓上堆滿書和文件的書房裡。

quiz.stem: In many Asian countries, it is a common ______ to remove your shoes before entering a home, so guests should remember to wear clean socks.
quiz.explain_zh: practice＝慣例、習俗。進門前脫鞋在許多亞洲國家是普遍的習俗。

quiz.stem: Knowing that the judges would be strict, Jason ______ himself for harsh comments before he walked onto the stage to sing.
quiz.explain_zh: steel＝使（自己）堅強起來。傑森上台前先做好心理準備，迎接嚴厲的評語。

quiz.stem: Professor Chen is regarded as one of the most ______ scholars in her field, having read and written widely on ancient Asian history.
quiz.explain_zh: learned＝博學的。陳教授博覽群書、著作豐富，是該領域最博學的學者之一。
